4. (Currently Amended) A method of __blocking__ Leishmaniasis transmission in __dogs__ by administering to __a dog__ a composition comprising fractions or sub-fractions of Leishmania promastigotes or Leishmania amastigotes called Fucose Mannose Ligand (FML) and saponin, __wherein the method comprises monitoring for blocking antibodies that impede transmission of Leishmania parasites from the vaccinated dog to sandfly vectors__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 4 wherein said composition is in the form of a __transmission-blocking__ vaccine __that reduces parasite availability to sandflies__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 4 wherein said composition further comprises suitable pharmacological vehicles, for blocking Leishmaniasis transmission in __dogs__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 4 wherein the Leishmania promastigotes or Leishmania amastigotes fractions called "Fucose Mannose Ligand" (FML) comprise a glycoprotein complex containing 29% of neutral sugar, 44% of protein, 11% of phosphate and hexoamines traces composed by protein bands with molecular weight ranging from 9 to 95 kDa, some protein bands having carbohydrates: 36 and 54 to 68 kDa, the FML glycidic portion presenting 10% of fucose and 47% of mannose, 30% of glucose, 12% of galactose and xylose traces, aminoacids containing 10 to 20% of glutamic acid, alanine, aspartic acid and glycine, 5 to 10% of serine, histidine, lysine, leucine, threonine, proline and valine, and 2 to 5% of arginine, methionine, isoleucine, tyrosine and phenylalanine, __and wherein the method includes measuring blocking antibody titers to confirm transmission-blocking efficacy__.
